rationale: RIOT has already gapped up 11.4% and is trading at 81% of its intraday range near session highs, with price consolidating tightly in the $16.03–16.10 zone over the last several candles — no clear directional breakout or rejection is forming. The broad market is strongly risk-on (SPY +1.61%, VIXY -8.06%), which supports the gap but also means much of the move is already priced in with limited asymmetry remaining. With a working short order already committed and no fresh catalyst, adding exposure in either direction here offers insufficient edge to justify a new position.
